definitions.explanation: A species of animal or plant that lives naturally in only one region and nowhere else.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{固有種|こゆうしゅ}。

examples.english: This island has many endemic species.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外来種|がいらいしゅ}→外来種：23243_gairaishu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧ことで、{固有種|こゆうしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生息地|せいそくち}→生息地：09253_seisokuchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{脅|おびや}かされている→脅かす：13942_obiyakasu⟧。
examples.english: The spread of introduced species is threatening the habitats of endemic species.

notes:
From ⟦{固有|こゆう}→固有：05615_koyuu⟧ (peculiar to, inherent) + ⟦{種|しゅ}→種：28584_shu⟧ (species).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日本固有種|にほんこゆうしゅ}: a species found only in Japan
- {固有種|こゆうしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to protect endemic species
- ⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{固有種|こゆうしゅ}: island endemics

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{在来種|ざいらいしゅ}→在来種：32481_zairaishu⟧: native species — native to an area, but it may live elsewhere too; a {固有種|こゆうしゅ} lives nowhere else
- ⟦{外来種|がいらいしゅ}→外来種：23243_gairaishu⟧: introduced species, the opposite of a native one
